namespaces.name: uk
namespaces.description: UK tax/NI thresholds, Bank of England Bank Rate, UK car tax (VED) and MOT rules, UK exam dates, UK government service steps, fees and processing times and UK CPI and CPIH inflation
namespaces.cadence: uk-rates: Every 6 April (new tax year) and after each Budget or Autumn Statement; minimum wage on 1 April; every source page re-fetched weekly. policy-rates: After each scheduled decision (eight a year per bank); re-verified within 45 days of verifiedDate; every source page re-fetched weekly. uk-vehicle-rules: Every 1 April (VED rates and the historic-vehicle exemption date move with the Finance Act) and after each Budget; MOT fees and rules when DVSA changes them; every source page re-fetched weekly. uk-exam-dates: Annual, calendar-driven: when JCQ and the boards publish the following summer's final timetables (early in the calendar year) and the results days; the weekly watcher hashes the JCQ and board timetable pages uk-gov-process: Re-verified against the gov.uk pages every 30 days and on fee-change days (Home Office fees usually move in April); every source page re-fetched weekly through the gov.uk content API. uk-inflation: Monthly, on the ONS CPI release day (stated as nextRelease in the series); every source page re-fetched weekly

namespaces.name: us
namespaces.description: Federal Reserve federal funds target range and US federal tax thresholds
namespaces.cadence: policy-rates: After each scheduled decision (eight a year per bank); re-verified within 45 days of verifiedDate; every source page re-fetched weekly. us-rates: Annual: after the IRS tax-year inflation adjustments (October), the retirement-plan limits (November), the SSA Federal Register notice (October/November) and the CMS Medicare amounts (November); source pages re-fetched weekly, ssa.gov read by hand.

namespaces.name: de
namespaces.cadence: de-rates: Annual: after the Sozialversicherungsrechengrößen-Verordnung and the Zusatzbeitrag announcement (November), and any Steuergesetz changing § 32a EStG for the next Veranlagungszeitraum; every source page re-fetched weekly.

namespaces.cadence: jp-vehicle-costs: Re-verified against the official pages every 35 days and on the known change dates (自賠責 2026-11-01, car taxes each 1 April, weight-tax eco bands 2027-05-01); every source page re-fetched weekly. jp-living-costs: Re-verified against the official pages every 35 days and on the known change dates (prefecture minimum wages 2026-10-01 to 2026-12-02 and each autumn, deductions 2026-12-01, insurance and pension rates each March/April, 高額療養費 2027-08-01, the 2028 holidays in February 2027); every source page re-fetched weekly.
